title: Ion-Mediated Regulation of Helical Gold Nanorods With Chirality-Photothermal Properties for Targeted Cancer Therapy.
abstract: Chiral plasmonic gold nanomaterials held significant promise for tumor photothermal therapy, with their helical pitch depth playing a critical role in determining both chirality and photothermal performance.
